mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation ( reservation_no, user_id, room_id, reserve_date, start_time, end_time, topic, attendee_count, contact, purpose, status ) VALUES ( 'PENDING_NO', #{userId}, #{roomId}, #{reserveDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{topic}, #{attendeeCount}, #{contact}, #{purpose}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT id, reservation_no, user_id, room_id, reserve_date, start_time, end_time, topic, attendee_count, contact, purpose, status, cancel_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM reservation WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
